name: Brid.TV
description: Integrates the Brid.TV video service, providing Brid.TV media handling.
project_description:
Integrates the Brid.TV video service provider into Drupal. 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module has no requirements, but integrates with the Media system and Paragraphs, if installed.

 The module has been initially build to work with the Thunder distribution . If you're using a different system and experience problems, feel free to report your problems in the issue queue .

 Back to top 

 Features overview 
 Once installed, the module provides

 
 A new media type "Brid.TV Video" (requires the Media system to be installed) 
 A new paragraph type "Brid.TV Embedded Video" (Paragraphs module required) 
 Optional synchronization of the videos with the provider 
 for developers: multiple services for using video data from Brid.TV. 
 
 Further planned features (not existing yet):

 
 An entity browser for browsing through existing Brid.TV Videos (requires the Entity Browser module to be installed) 
 An upload section for directly uploading new videos to Brid.TV.
